Biography as supplied.

Sofia is studying RNA structure evolution across diverse organisms. Her master's research focuses on understanding how functional constraints shape RNA secondary structure evolution, with applications to understanding viral adaptation.

Areas of expertise

RNA Structure · Comparative Genomics · Molecular Evolution

Education as supplied

  • BS in Molecular Biology, University of Texas at Austin

Research interests

  • RNA structure prediction
  • Comparative genomics
  • Functional constraint analysis
  • Viral RNA evolution

Publication records as supplied
